entries.german: Erlaubnis für Philipp v. Boyneburg zu Laudenbach zur Anweisung eines Wittums für seine Frau, geb. v. Rosenberg
entries.english: Permission for Philipp v. Boyneburg zu Laudenbach to assign a dower for his wife, née v. Rosenberg

facts.subject: the wife of Philipp von Boyneburg, born von Rosenberg
facts.content: was to receive a Wittum under an authorization granted to her husband.
